info.name: Zimos Backend
info.description:
Every mounted endpoint of the Zimos API, organised by module, with per-request PURPOSE / SEND / EXPECT notes taken from the actual Joi schemas, Sequelize models and controllers.

## Setup
1. Import this collection **and** `zimos.postman_environment.json`; select the environment.
2. Run **Auth > Login** once — its test script fills `{{accessToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}` for every staff request.
3. Set `{{workspaceId}}` (run **Workspaces & Team > List My Workspaces**, or **Quickstart Demo Flow > 02**).

## Auth model
- **Collection default:** `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` — inherited by all the staff folders (Auth, Workspaces & Team, Catalog, Inventory, Customers, Orders, COD Confirmation, Payments, Discounts, Shipping, Tax Rates, Pages, Funnels, Store Branding & Products, Custom Domains, Billing, Admin).
- **No auth:** the `Public Storefront`, `Public Shop`, and `Cart` folders — this is what a buyer-facing frontend hits.
- Login/Register/Refresh/etc. and a few HTML routes override to no-auth individually.

## Conventions
- `{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`. `{{rootUrl}}` = `http://localhost:4000` (only `Public Shop`, `/health`, `/docs` live outside `/api/v1`).
- All money is **integer minor units** (piastres/cents) — `19900` = 199.00.
- Path ids shown as `:name` are Postman path variables — fill them per-request; ids captured by test scripts (workspaceId, productId, variantId, orderId, funnelId, …) are collection variables set for you as you go.
- Errors follow `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details", "requestId" } }`.

item.name: Quickstart Demo Flow
item.description:
The fastest way to see the whole system work end to end before diving into individual endpoints.
Run these **in order** — each step feeds the next via collection/environment variables:

1. **01 Login** captures `accessToken` + `refreshToken` automatically.
2. **02 List Workspaces** captures the first workspace id into `workspaceId`.
3. **03 Add First Product** publishes a store with one product (returns HTML).
4. **04 Add Second Product** shows the store is multi-product.
5. **05 Update Store Branding** sets a name / logo / tagline.
6. **06 View Store Home** opens the buyer-facing rendered grid (no auth) — branding + both products.
7. **07 List Store Products (JSON)** captures a `productId` for the next step.
8. **08 View Product Detail** opens one product's rendered page.
9. **09 Submit Checkout** places a COD order for that product; captures `orderId` from the redirect.
10. **10 Get Order** reads the created order back as staff.

Prereqs: the API running on `http://localhost:4000`, a migrated + seeded DB, and a verified user account. Register once via `Auth > Register` if you have none.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Authenticate and set up auth for every other request in this collection.

**SEND:**
Required: `email`, `password`. Example above uses the demo seed account.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ user, accessToken, refreshToken, sessionId, expiresAt }`. The test script stores `accessToken`/`refreshToken` as collection variables.
- `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` — wrong email or password (same message for both).
- `401 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken + refreshToken to collection variables.');

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Pick the workspace whose store you want to set up (a merchant dashboard would show this list).

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token only. No body, no params.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ workspaces: [ { workspace: { id, name, slug, status, defaultCurrency, ... }, role: { key, name } } ] }`. The test script copies `workspaces[0].workspace.id` into `workspaceId`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

exec: console.warn('No workspaces — create one via Workspaces & Team > Create Workspace, then re-run.');

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Add the first product: creates the product/variant/offer + stock and publishes a store "/" page listing all active products.

**SEND:**
Required: `productName`, `price` (string like "199.00"). Optional: `currency` (3, default `EGP`), `stock` (int ≥ 0, default 100), `imageUrl`, `description`, `bullets` (one per line). Auth: Bearer, or `?token=` / hidden `token` field. Content-Type form-urlencoded (JSON also accepted).

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html** — "Published — your store is live" linking to `/shop/{{workspaceId}}`. Goes through the real `pagesService` publish path.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`.
- `422` — form re-rendered with an error (e.g. price not > 0).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

urlencoded.value: The only widget you will ever need.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Add a second product — the store "/" page regenerates to list BOTH products (it never recreates the website).

**SEND:**
Same fields as step 03. Required: `productName`, `price`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html**. The store now has two active products.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED` / `422` / `401` / `403`.

**PURPOSE:** Set the store name / logo / tagline. Patches the `Workspace`; the public store reads it live, no republish.

**SEND:**
At least one of `name` (2–200), `logoUrl` (URL), `tagline` (≤300). form-urlencoded.

**EXPECT:**
`303` redirect back to the "my store" page.
- `422` / `402` / `401` / `403`.

**PURPOSE:** The buyer-facing store home: logo + name + tagline + a grid of both products.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. Public. Host is `{{rootUrl}}` (`http://localhost:4000`), NOT `{{baseUrl}}`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html** — contains "Ahmed Emporium", the tagline, and both product names/prices.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — no published store (run step 03).

**PURPOSE:** The public product-list JSON — used here just to grab a `productId` for the next step.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. Public.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ products: [ { id, name, slug, ... } ], nextCursor }`. The test script copies `products[0].id` into `productId`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — workspace not active.

exec: if (b.products && b.products.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', b.products[0].id); console.log('productId =', b.products[0].id); }

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** One product's rendered detail page — image, name, price, description, bullets, Buy now.

**SEND:**
Required: `{{productId}}` (captured in step 07). Public.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html** — the Buy now link is `/shop/{{workspaceId}}/checkout?productId={{productId}}`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Place a guest COD order for `{{productId}}` — the buyer "Place order" button.

**SEND:**
Required: `fullName`, `phone`, `addressLine`, `city`, and `productId` (the store now has two products). Optional: `country` (2, default `EG`). form-urlencoded. Calls the same `orderService.createOrder` staff uses. Redirect-following is off so the test script can read the new order id from `Location`.

**EXPECT:**
`303` redirect → `Location: /shop/{{workspaceId}}/thanks/<orderId>`. Test script captures `orderId`.
- `400`/`422` — re-rendered checkout form with an error.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — no published store.

exec: pm.test('303 redirect to thank-you page', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(303));

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Read the order the guest just placed — what an order-detail screen in the merchant dashboard shows.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token, `ORDERS_VIEW` permission, `:orderId` (captured in step 09).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ order: { id, orderNumber, confirmationState, financialState, fulfillmentState, paymentMethod, currency, subtotalAmount, discountAmount, shippingAmount, taxAmount, totalAmount, contactSnapshot, shippingAddressSnapshot, items: [...], payments: [...], shipments: [...] } }`. All amounts are integer minor units (piastres).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — order not in this workspace.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
`/api/v1/auth/*` — account + session lifecycle.

**Public (no login):** Register, Verify Email, Login, Login with Google, Google OAuth Callback, Refresh Token, Logout, Password Reset (email or SMS) Request/Confirm. This is what a public sign-in / sign-up screen hits.
**Staff (Bearer):** Get Me, List Sessions, Revoke All Sessions, Verify Phone Request/Confirm — an account-settings screen (Verify Phone also accepts a just-registered `pending_verification` token).

Run **Login** once and its test script fills `{{accessToken}}` / `{{refreshToken}}` for the whole collection.

Transactional email (verification, password reset, workspace invites) is rendered from a template with a shared "check your spam folder" footer and sent via `EMAIL_PROVIDER` — `console` (logs the token, default / tests) or `brevo` (real send via the Brevo API using `BREVO_API_KEY` + `EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS`).

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Create a new user account (public sign-up screen). Returns tokens immediately; email verification is separate.

**SEND:**
Required: `email`, `password` (8–200 chars), `fullName` (2–200). Optional: `phone` (≤32).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ user: { id, email, fullName, phone, status:"pending_verification", ... }, accessToken, refreshToken, sessionId, expiresAt }`.
- `409 EMAIL_TAKEN` — email already registered.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — e.g. password too short.
- `429 RATE_LIMITED` — auth endpoints are throttled per IP+email.

**PURPOSE:** Confirm the address from the emailed verification link — flips `user.status` to `active`.

**SEND:**
Required: `token` (the opaque string from the verification email; in dev the console/mock provider logs it).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ user: { ..., status:"active", emailVerifiedAt } }`.
- `400`/`404` — token unknown, already used, or expired.
- `422` — missing token.

**PURPOSE:** Exchange email + password for tokens (sign-in screen). Test script auto-saves the tokens.

**SEND:**
Required: `email`, `password`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ user, accessToken, refreshToken, sessionId, expiresAt }`. `accessToken` is a ~15-min JWT (send as `Authorization: Bearer`); `refreshToken` is an opaque 30-day string.
- `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` — wrong email or password (deliberately identical for both).
- `401 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`.
- `422` / `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken + refreshToken to collection variables.');

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Start Google sign-in. A browser hits this (the "Sign in with Google" button `href`) and is 302-redirected to Google's consent screen.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. No body, no auth. Requires `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` / `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI` in the server's `.env`.

**EXPECT:**
`302` redirect to `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?...` (scope `openid email profile`). Postman with redirects on will show the Google page HTML; the real flow only makes sense in a browser.

**PURPOSE:** Google redirects the browser here after consent. NOT meant to be called directly — the `code` is single-use and only Google produces a valid one, so the token exchange cannot be exercised from Postman without a real consent flow.

**SEND:**
Query from Google: `code` on success, or `error` (e.g. `access_denied`) if the user declined. The server exchanges `code` for the Google profile (email, name, `sub`), then: if a user with that `googleId` exists it logs them in; else if a user with that email exists it links `googleId` to that account and logs in; else it creates a new `active`, email-verified, passwordless user and logs in.

**EXPECT:**
`302` redirect to `${FRONTEND_URL}/auth/callback?accessToken=...&refreshToken=...` on success (default `FRONTEND_URL` = `http://localhost:5173`), or `?error=<code>` on failure or a Google denial. The tokens are the same access + refresh pair the email/password login issues.

**PURPOSE:** Rotate an expiring access token without re-entering the password (call when a request 401s with an expired token).

**SEND:**
Required: `refreshToken` (the opaque string from Login).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ accessToken, refreshToken, sessionId, expiresAt }` — a NEW refresh token; the old one is now invalid (rotation).
- `401` — refresh token unknown, expired, revoked, or already rotated.
- `422`.

**PURPOSE:** Revoke one session (the "sign out" button).

**SEND:**
Required: `refreshToken`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }` (also returns success if the token was already invalid).
- `422` — missing token.

**PURPOSE:** Load the signed-in user for the app shell / account menu.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token only.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ user: { id, email, fullName, phone, status, emailVerifiedAt, lastLoginAt, createdAt, updatedAt } }` (never includes the password hash).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** Show every active/past login for a "devices & sessions" settings screen.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token only.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ sessions: [ { id, userAgent, ipAddress, createdAt, expiresAt, revokedAt, isActive } ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** Force sign-out everywhere ("log out of all devices").

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token only. No body.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }` — every refresh token for this user is revoked; existing access tokens still work until they expire (~15 min).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** "Forgot password" screen — emails a reset token.

**SEND:**
Required: `email`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }` **always** (never reveals whether the email exists — no account enumeration).
- `422` / `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

**PURPOSE:** Set a new password using the emailed token.

**SEND:**
Required: `token`, `newPassword` (8–200).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }`.
- `400`/`404` — token unknown, used, or expired.
- `422` — new password too short.

**PURPOSE:** Send a 6-digit SMS code to verify a phone number (used right after registering — a `pending_verification` account is allowed here).

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token, `phone` (6–32). The code is valid 5 minutes; at most 3 codes per phone per 10 minutes. Sent via `SMS_PROVIDER` (`console` logs it, default/tests; `twilio` really sends it).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ sent: true }`.
- `429 OTP_RATE_LIMITED` — more than 3 requests in 10 minutes.
- `422 INVALID_PHONE`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** Confirm the SMS code — stores the normalized phone on the user and stamps `phoneVerifiedAt`.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token, `phone`, `code` (exactly 6 digits).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ user: { ..., phone, phoneVerifiedAt } }`.
- `422 INVALID_CODE` — wrong code.
- `422 EXPIRED` — code older than 5 minutes.
- `429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS` — 6th wrong guess for that code.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** "Forgot password" via SMS — texts a 6-digit code to a user whose phone is verified.

**SEND:**
Required: `phone`. Enumeration-safe.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }` **always** (whether or not a verified phone matches).
- `429 OTP_RATE_LIMITED`.
- `422` / `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

**PURPOSE:** Set a new password using the SMS code. Revokes every existing session on success.

**SEND:**
Required: `phone`, `code` (6 digits), `newPassword` (8–200).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }`.
- `422 INVALID_CODE` / `422 EXPIRED` / `429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`.
- `422` — new password too short.

item.name: Workspaces & Team
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/*` — the tenant boundary + team management. **All staff (Bearer).**

`Create Workspace` and `List My Workspaces` only need a valid token. The member/role endpoints also need `resolveTenant` (you must be an active member of `:workspaceId`) plus a permission (`users.manage` / `roles.manage`).

Creating a workspace also seeds its 6 system roles, an owner Membership, an invoice counter, and a `trialing` Subscription.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Onboarding — create a new store/tenant. The creator becomes its Owner.

**SEND:**
Required: `name` (2–200). Bearer token only (no tenant/permission check).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ workspace: { id, name, slug, ownerUserId, status:"active", defaultCurrency:"EGP", defaultLocale:"ar-EG", timezone:"Africa/Cairo", settings:{}, createdAt, updatedAt } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** The workspace switcher — every workspace the signed-in user belongs to, plus their role in each.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token only.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ workspaces: [ { workspace: { id, name, slug, status, ... }, role: { key, name } } ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** The team table — everyone attached to the workspace, active members and pending invites alike.

**SEND:**
Required: `users.manage`. No params.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ members: [ { id, workspaceId, userId, roleId, status, invitedEmail, user: { id, email, fullName, status } | null, role: { id, key, name } } ] }` (oldest first; `user` is `null` for a not-yet-accepted invite).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — you are not a member of `:workspaceId` (identical response whether it exists or not).

**PURPOSE:** Just the invites that have not been accepted yet (`status:"invited"`).

**SEND:**
Required: `users.manage`. No params.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ invites: [ { id, workspaceId, roleId, status:"invited", invitedEmail, role: { id, key, name } } ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — you are not a member of `:workspaceId` (identical response whether it exists or not).

**PURPOSE:** Team settings — add a colleague by email and assign a role. Sends them an invite email (`workspace_invite` template) through the notification provider.

**SEND:**
Required: `email`, `roleId` (uuid of a role in this workspace). Permission: `users.manage`. If the email already has an account they are added as an active member; otherwise the membership is created with `status:"invited"` and `userId:null`, keyed on `invitedEmail`, and linked to the real user when they accept.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ membership: { id, workspaceId, userId, roleId, status, invitedEmail } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — role not in this workspace (or you are not a member).
- `409 ALREADY_MEMBER` — that user is already in the workspace.
- `409 ALREADY_INVITED` — that email already has a pending invite.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Re-send the invite email for a still-pending invite.

**SEND:**
Required: `users.manage`, `:membershipId` (a membership whose `status` is `invited`). No body.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ resent: true, email }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — membership not in this workspace.
- `409 NOT_PENDING` — that invite has already been accepted.

**PURPOSE:** Change a teammate's role from the team table.

**SEND:**
Required: `roleId`. Permission: `users.manage`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ membership }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — membership or role not in this workspace.
- `409 LAST_OWNER` — cannot demote the only remaining Owner.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Remove a teammate from the workspace.

**SEND:**
Required: `:membershipId`. Permission: `users.manage`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ success: true }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `409 LAST_OWNER` — cannot remove the only Owner.

**PURPOSE:** Roles & permissions settings — define a role with a hand-picked permission set.

**SEND:**
Required: `name` (2–100), `key` (2–64, `^[a-z0-9_]+$`), `permissions` (non-empty array; each must be one of the canonical permission strings such as `website.edit`, `orders.manage`, `products.view`, `funnels.manage`, `billing.manage`, …).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ role: { id, workspaceId, key, name, isSystem:false, permissions:[...] } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` — `key` already used in this workspace.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field. (unknown permission string).

item.name: Catalog
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/catalog/*` — products, variants, offers, collections. **All staff (Bearer)** + `resolveTenant`.
Read: `products.view`. Write: `products.manage`.

**Money is always integer minor units** (e.g. `priceAmount: 19900` = 199.00 EGP). Stock is set once at variant creation; every later change goes through the **Inventory** folder.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Add a product to the catalog (product editor "create").

**SEND:**
Required: `name` (1–300). Optional: `slug` (auto from name if omitted), `description` (≤20000), `productType` (`physical`|`digital`|`service`, default `physical`), `status` (`draft`|`active`|`archived`, default `draft`), `options` (`[{ name, values:[] }]`), `media` (`[]`), `tags` (`[string]`), `seo` (`{}`), `websiteId`. `productCode` is **server-assigned**, not accepted in the body.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ product: { id, productCode: "<9 digits>", workspaceId, websiteId, name, slug, description, productType, status, options, media, tags, seo, createdAt, updatedAt } }`. `productCode` is a unique 9-digit numeric string, distinct from the UUID `id`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** The product list table in the dashboard.

**SEND:**
Required: `products.view`. Query (all optional): `status` (`draft`|`active`|`archived`), `collectionId` (uuid), `limit` (1–200, default 50), `cursor` (uuid — pass the previous `nextCursor`).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ products: [ { ...product (incl. `productCode`), variants: [...], offers: [...] } ], nextCursor: <uuid|null> }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Full product detail for the editor — includes variants, offers (with their lines), and collections.

**SEND:**
Required: `products.view`, `:productId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ product: { ...fields (incl. `productCode`, the 9-digit code), variants:[...], offers:[{ ..., lines:[{ variantId, quantity }] }], collections:[...] } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — not in this workspace.

**PURPOSE:** Save edits from the product editor.

**SEND:**
Required: `products.manage`. Body: any subset of the Create Product fields (all optional here). `productCode` is fixed at creation and cannot be changed.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ product }` (still carries the unchanged `productCode`).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Remove a product from the catalog. **Soft delete** — order history keeps its own OrderItem snapshots, but variants also anchor inventory movement history, so the product plus all its variants and offers are set to `status:"archived"` rather than being row-deleted.

**SEND:**
Required: `products.manage`, `:productId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ archived: true, id }`. The product, its variants and its offers are now `archived` (hidden from the storefront and default lists; still readable by id; existing orders unchanged; no new orders can be placed for it).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — not in this workspace.

**PURPOSE:** Read a single variant by id (variant editor open).

**SEND:**
Required: `products.view`, `:variantId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ variant: { id, productId, sku, priceAmount, stockOnHand, reservedStock, status, ... } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Add a buyable variant (size/colour row) to a product.

**SEND:**
Required: `priceAmount` (integer ≥ 0, minor units). Optional: `sku` (≤100, unique per workspace when set), `barcode`, `optionValues` (`{}`), `compareAtAmount`, `costAmount`, `currency` (3, default `EGP`), `allowOverselling` (default `false`), `weightGrams`, `dimensions`, `stockOnHand` (integer ≥ 0, default 0 — **only settable here**).

**EXPECT:**

item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/orders/*` — the shared commerce engine. **Staff (Bearer).**
Read: `orders.view`. Create: `orders.manage`.

`POST /orders` **requires an `Idempotency-Key` header** — N identical retries create exactly one order. Prices are computed server-side from the DB; anything you send as a price is ignored. Order state is 3 independent machines (`confirmationState`, `financialState`, `fulfillmentState`).

header.description: Required. Any unique string; reusing it replays the first response.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Staff-side manual order entry (phone order, replacement order). The public buyer flow is Public Storefront > Checkout.

**SEND:**
Header: `Idempotency-Key` (required — any unique string). Body — required: `items` (≥ 1 × `{ variantId, offerId?, quantity ≥ 1 }`), `contact` (`{ fullName, phone, alternatePhone?, email? }`), `paymentMethod` (`cod`|`card`|`wallet`|`bank_transfer`). Optional: `shippingAddress` (`{ country(2), province?, city, addressLine, postalCode?, notes? }` — omitted ⇒ 0 shipping/tax), `discountCode`, `funnelId`, `websiteId`, `notes` (≤2000). Permission: `orders.manage`.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ order: { id, orderNumber, customerId, confirmationState:"pending", financialState:"pending", fulfillmentState:"unfulfilled", paymentMethod, currency, subtotalAmount, discountAmount, shippingAmount, taxAmount, totalAmount, contactSnapshot, shippingAddressSnapshot, discountsSnapshot, riskFlags, items:[{ id, productNameSnapshot, variantOptionsSnapshot, skuSnapshot, offerNameSnapshot, quantity, unitPriceAmount, lineTotalAmount }] } }`. COD orders also get a ConfirmationTask queued.
- `400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` — header missing.
- `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT` — same key, different body.
- `409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` — not enough available stock (unless the variant allows overselling).
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — a `variantId`/`offerId` is not in this workspace.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** The orders table with the usual status filters.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`. Query (optional): `limit` (1–200, default 50), `cursor` (uuid), `confirmationState` (`pending`|`confirmed`|`rejected`|`unreachable`|`postponed`), `financialState` (`pending`|`partially_paid`|`paid`|`failed`|`refunded`|`partially_refunded`), `fulfillmentState` (`unfulfilled`|`partially_fulfilled`|`fulfilled`|`returned`).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ orders: [ { ...order, items:[...] } ], nextCursor }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Order detail screen.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`, `:orderId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ order: { ...all order fields, items:[...], payments:[...], shipments:[...] } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — not in this workspace.

**PURPOSE:** Direct merchant cancellation (distinct from a COD confirmation rejection). Releases the inventory **reservation** (stock returns to available; nothing is permanently deducted since nothing shipped), moves `confirmationState` to `rejected`, cancels any not-yet-collected shipment, closes any open confirmation task, and records the reason.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.manage`, `:orderId`, `reason` (1–500). No effect on `financialState` — refunding a paid order is a separate action.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ order: { ..., cancelledAt, cancellationReason, confirmationState:"rejected", items:[...] } }`.
- `409 ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED` — a shipment is already picked up / in transit / delivered.
- `409 ORDER_ALREADY_CANCELLED`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.manage`, `:orderId`, at least one of `shippingAddress` (`{ country(2), province?, city, addressLine, postalCode?, notes? }`) or `notes` (≤2000). Does NOT re-price shipping/tax.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ order }`.
- `409 ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED` / `409 ORDER_CANCELLED`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body had no allowed field.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`, `:orderId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ shipments: [ { id, orderId, trackingCode, carrierCode, waybillNumber, status, trackingUrl, shippedAt, deliveredAt } ] }`. `trackingCode` (`zg` + 9 digits) is the human-facing reference — use it, not the UUID `id`.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ shipment: { id, orderId, trackingCode:"zg" + 9 digits, carrierCode, waybillNumber, status:"created", trackingUrl, shippedAt:null, deliveredAt:null } }`. `trackingCode` is generated server-side (unique, collision-retried) and is what you show to a person / put on the parcel.
- `409 ORDER_CANCELLED`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Manually advance a shipment. Also keeps the order's `fulfillmentState` in step (via the order state service): `picked_up`/`in_transit`/`out_for_delivery` ⇒ `partially_fulfilled`, `delivered` ⇒ `fulfilled`, `returned` ⇒ `returned`. `shippedAt` is stamped on the first in-motion status; `deliveredAt` on `delivered`.

`200` `{ shipment }`.

- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.manage`, `:orderId`, `reasonCode` (`damaged`|`defective`|`wrong_item`|`not_as_described`|`no_longer_wanted`|`arrived_late`|`other`), `items` (≥ 1 × `{ orderItemId, quantity ≥ 1 }` — each `orderItemId` must be a line on this order; `quantity` ≤ the quantity ordered on that line). Optional: `reasonDetail` (≤280, appended to the stored reason).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ return: { id, workspaceId, orderId, reason, status:"requested", items:[{ orderItemId, quantity }], restockedAt:null } }`.
- `409 ORDER_NOT_DELIVERED` — the order has not been delivered.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`, `:orderId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ returns: [ { id, orderId, reason, status, items, restockedAt } ] }` (newest first).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`, `:orderId`. No body.

**EXPECT:**
The PDF shows: the store name (its logo if `logoUrl` loads, text-only if it doesn't), the tracking code as text **and** a Code128 barcode (the newest shipment's `trackingCode` — `zg` + 9 digits — or the order number if there is no shipment yet), the delivery name / phone / address from `order.shippingAddressSnapshot` + `contactSnapshot`, the payment method, a prominent **"COLLECT ON DELIVERY"** amount for COD orders (nothing to collect for prepaid), and the order date.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — order not in this workspace.

- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

item.name: Returns
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/returns/*` — the workspace-wide returns queue and moderation. **Staff (Bearer).** Opening a return is order-scoped (see **Orders > Open Return**).

Restocking is **never** automatic. Approving a return does not move stock — a separate explicit `POST /returns/:id/restock` call (which needs `inventory.manage`) adds the units back via `inventoryService.returnRestock` and writes an `InventoryMovement`.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** The returns queue across all orders.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.view`. Query (optional): `status` (`requested`|`approved`|`rejected`|`received`|`refunded`).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ returns: [ { id, orderId, reason, status, items, restockedAt } ] }` (newest first).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — you are not a member of `:workspaceId` (identical response whether it exists or not).

**PURPOSE:** Moderate a pending return. **Does not touch stock** — restock is a separate call.

**SEND:**
Required: `orders.manage`, `:returnId`, `action` (`approve` ⇒ status `approved`; `reject` ⇒ status `rejected`). Only a return still in `requested` can be moderated.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ return }`.
- `409 RETURN_NOT_PENDING` — already approved/rejected/received.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Create a website container (one workspace can have several).

**SEND:**
Required: `name` (1–200). Optional: `subdomain` (3–63, `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$`; auto-generated from name if omitted), `globalStyles` (`{}`), `seo` (`{}`). Permission: `website.edit` + active subscription.

item.name: Funnels
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/funnels/*` — a funnel is a directed graph of steps. **Staff (Bearer).**
Manage steps/edges: `funnels.manage`. Publish/rollback/pause: `funnels.publish`. Creating a funnel and publishing also require an **active subscription**.

Same draft/publish/revision discipline as Pages. A step's `builderData` is a page tree (identical rules to Pages). The public runtime is in **Public Storefront** (`/store/:workspaceId/funnels`).

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Create a funnel container.

**SEND:**
Required: `name` (1–200). Optional: `subdomain`. Permission: `funnels.manage` + active subscription.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ funnel: { id, workspaceId, name, subdomain, status:"draft", publishedRevisionId:null } }`.

`200` `{ funnels: [ { id, name, subdomain, status, publishedRevisionId } ] }`.

- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Rename a funnel.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`; `name`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ funnel }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Delete a funnel (steps/edges/revisions/sessions cascade).

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:funnelId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ deleted: true }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Add a step (page) to the funnel graph.

**SEND:**
Required: `key` (lowercase slug 1–100, immutable, referenced by edges), `stepType` (`landing`|`sales`|`opt_in`|`checkout`|`upsell`|`downsell`|`thank_you`|`custom`), `name` (1–200). Optional: `builderData` (page tree — same rules & element types as Pages), `offerId` (uuid — **required for `upsell`/`downsell` at publish time**; validated to be an active offer in the workspace), `seo` (`{}`). Permission: `funnels.manage`.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ step: { id, workspaceId, funnelId, key, stepType, name, builderData, offerId, abTestExperimentId, seo } }`.
- `409 FUNNEL_STEP_KEY_TAKEN` — `key` already used in this funnel.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — raw-HTML/unknown-element `builderData`, or `offerId` not an active workspace offer.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — funnel not in this workspace.

**PURPOSE:** All steps of a funnel.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:funnelId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ steps: [ {...} ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Load one step into the editor.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:stepId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ step: {...} }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Save step edits. `key` cannot change (edges reference it). Send `offerId: null` to clear an offer.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`; at least one of `stepType`, `name`, `builderData`, `offerId`, `seo`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ step }`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — bad `builderData`, or `offerId` not active.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Delete a step; any draft edges touching its `key` are removed too.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:stepId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ deleted: true }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** Connect two steps. At runtime the engine walks the highest-`priority` outbound edge whose `condition` matches the step outcome.

**SEND:**

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ edge: { id, workspaceId, funnelId, fromStepKey, toStepKey, condition, priority } }`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — an endpoint step key does not exist, or an unknown `condition.type`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — funnel not in this workspace.

**PURPOSE:** All edges, ordered by priority desc.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:funnelId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ edges: [ {...} ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Re-route or re-prioritise an edge.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`; at least one of `fromStepKey`, `toStepKey`, `condition`, `priority`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ edge }`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — endpoint step missing / bad condition.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Remove an edge.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:edgeId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ deleted: true }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Validate the graph and freeze it into a numbered revision that the public runtime serves.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.publish` + active subscription, `:funnelId`. Optional: `note` (≤300).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ funnel: { ...status:"published", publishedRevisionId }, revision: { id, revisionNumber, note, createdAt } }`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — collected graph problems: not exactly one entry step (a step with no inbound edge), an unreachable step, an edge pointing at a missing step, an empty step tree, or an `upsell`/`downsell` step with no `offerId`.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Funnel version history.

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.manage`, `:funnelId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ revisions: [ { id, revisionNumber, note, publishedByUserId, createdAt, stepCount } ] }` (newest first).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Point the live funnel at an earlier revision (drafts untouched).

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.publish`, `:funnelId`, `:revisionId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ funnel, rolledBackTo: { id, revisionNumber } }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Temporarily take a published funnel offline (keeps the revision).

**SEND:**
Required: `funnels.publish`, `:funnelId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ funnel: { ...status:"paused" } }` — the public runtime then returns `410 FUNNEL_PAUSED`.
- `409 FUNNEL_NOT_PUBLISHED` — funnel was never published.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).

**PURPOSE:** Bring a paused funnel back online.

Required: `funnels.publish`, `:funnelId`.

item.name: Store Branding & Products
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/quickstart*` — simple merchant store manager. **Returns HTML**, not JSON.

**Auth is flexible:** a `Authorization: Bearer` header works, OR (for a plain browser) `?token=<jwt>` on a GET and a hidden `token` field on a POST. Permissions: `website.edit` (GET / branding), `website.publish` + active subscription (add product).

The store is now **multi-product**: `GET` shows a "my store" page (branding form + product list + "add another") once a product exists, or the add-product form when empty (also forced with `?add=1`). Each `POST` to `/quickstart` adds ONE product and republishes the store `/` page listing **all** active products — it never recreates the website. The buyer-facing rendered result lives in **Public Shop** (`/shop/:workspaceId`).

query.description: force the add-product form even when products exist
only for a no-header browser open

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Merchant landing: the "my store" page (branding + product list + "add another product") once at least one product exists, otherwise the empty add-product form. `?add=1` always shows the form.

**SEND:**
Required: `website.edit`. Auth via Bearer header or `?token=`. No body.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html**.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — no token in header OR query.
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Add one product: `catalogService.createProduct` + `createVariant` + `inventoryService.restock` + `createOffer`, then regenerate & republish the store "/" page listing all active products.

**SEND:**
Content-Type `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (JSON also accepted). Required: `productName` (1–200), `price` (string, e.g. "199.00", must parse to > 0). Optional: `currency` (3, default `EGP`), `stock` (integer ≥ 0, default 100), `imageUrl` (URL), `description` (≤4000), `bullets` (newline-separated, ≤10 kept). Permission: `website.publish` + active subscription.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html** — a "Published — your store is live" page linking to `/shop/{{workspaceId}}`.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`.
- `422` — form re-rendered with an inline error (e.g. price not > 0).
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` / `403 FORBIDDEN`.

urlencoded.value: The only widget you will ever need.

urlencoded.description: only if not sending a Bearer header

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Set the store name / logo / tagline — the demo EJS "my store" form path. Patches the `Workspace`; the public store reads these live (no republish). For a real (React) frontend use the JSON PATCH below instead — it also carries `themeSettings`.

**SEND:**
Content-Type form-urlencoded. At least one of: `name` (2–200), `logoUrl` (URL, `""` clears), `tagline` (≤300, `""` clears). Permission: `website.edit` + active subscription.

**EXPECT:**
`303` redirect back to the "my store" page (`?saved=1`).
- `422` — "my store" page re-rendered with an error.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` / `403 FORBIDDEN`.

**PURPOSE:** The real merchant-facing update for a separate React storefront frontend: branding + an opaque `themeSettings` blob the frontend defines and interprets (template choice, colours, …). The backend stores and returns `themeSettings` verbatim — it never validates its contents.

**SEND:**
JSON body, at least one of: `name` (2–200), `logoUrl` (URL; `""`/`null` clears), `tagline` (≤300; `""`/`null` clears), `themeSettings` (object, ≤50 keys / ~5KB). Permission: `website.edit` + active subscription.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ workspace: { id, name, logoUrl, tagline, themeSettings } }`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — bad field or `themeSettings` over ~5KB.
- `402 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` / `403 FORBIDDEN`.

item.name: Custom Domains
item.description:
`/api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/domains/*` — **Staff (Bearer)** + `domain.manage`.

A merchant points their own domain (e.g. `ahmedstore.com`) at the store. **We do not manage TLS** — the merchant runs Cloudflare (free) in front of the domain and Cloudflare terminates HTTPS. We only record the domain and verify control of it via a DNS **TXT** record.

Once a domain is `verified`, a request whose `Host` header is that domain is internally served as that workspace's store (see the subdomain note in **Public Shop**). A `pending_verification` domain's host shows a plain "not verified yet" page instead of a broken store.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Register a domain the merchant owns. Stores it as `pending_verification` and returns the TXT record they must add.

**SEND:**
Required: `hostname` (a bare domain like `ahmedstore.com`; protocol/path/trailing dot are stripped, lower-cased). The workspace must already have a store (a website) — add a product first. A `${PLATFORM_ROOT_DOMAIN}` subdomain is rejected (it already works).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ domain: { id, hostname, status:"pending_verification", verifiedAt:null }, record: { type:"TXT", name:"<hostname>", value:"zimos-verify=<token>" }, next: "..." }`. Test script captures `domainId`.
- `409 STORE_NOT_SET_UP` — no store yet.
- `409 DOMAIN_TAKEN` — hostname already connected to a store.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — not a valid domain, or a platform subdomain.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** All domains connected to this workspace, with their current status and the TXT record for each.

**SEND:**
Required: `domain.manage`. No params.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ domains: [ { id, hostname, status, verifiedAt, record: { type, name, value } } ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Check that the TXT record is live. One DNS lookup, no retries — call it again after DNS propagates.

**SEND:**
Required: `domain.manage`, `:domainId`. No body.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ domain: { id, hostname, status:"verified", verifiedAt } }` when the `zimos-verify=<token>` TXT record is found at the hostname (already-verified domains return `200` unchanged).
- `400 DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED` — record not found yet (or the domain does not resolve); status stays `pending_verification`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — domain not in this workspace.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

**PURPOSE:** Disconnect a domain. **Hard delete** — a `Domain` row only drives `Host` header → workspace routing; nothing in order or financial history references it, so there is nothing to preserve.

**SEND:**
Required: `domain.manage`, `:domainId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ deleted: true, id }`. Requests with that `Host` header stop resolving to this store.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — domain not in this workspace.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/expired Bearer token (run Auth > Login first).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — your workspace role lacks the required permission.

item.name: Public Storefront
item.description:
`/api/v1/store/:workspaceId/*` — **PUBLIC. No login.** This is exactly what a buyer-facing storefront frontend (the separate React app, a mobile app) calls to render its own template layouts. `resolvePublicWorkspace` only checks the workspace exists and is `active` — there is no membership/permission check.

Contains: **Storefront Meta** (branding + `themeSettings`), published page render-data, public product/collection browsing, product **reviews**, the guest **Checkout** — cart-based *or* **Buy Now** (a single `item` in the body, no cart) — and the public **Funnel runtime**. The guest cart is a sibling folder (**Cart**).
Everything here returns a deliberately narrowed projection — no cost price, no drafts, no internal fields.

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** The page-shell data a storefront frontend needs before rendering any of its template layouts: store name, logo, tagline, and the opaque `themeSettings` blob the frontend owns.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. Public. No body/params.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ store: { id, name, slug, logoUrl, tagline, themeSettings, currency } }`. `themeSettings` is whatever the frontend last saved via `PATCH .../quickstart/branding` (default `{}`); the backend never interprets it. Works before any product exists.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — workspace missing or not `active`.

**PURPOSE:** Fetch render data for the live site — the storefront frontend turns `page.tree` into DOM.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. Query (optional): `path` (default `/`), `format` (`json` default, or `html` to get a server-rendered page instead — a browser sending `Accept: text/html` also gets HTML).

**EXPECT:**
`200 JSON` `{ page: { path, title, pageType, tree, seo, og: { title, description, image, url, type } }, site: { name, subdomain, globalStyles, seo } }`. OR `200` with `{ redirect: { to, statusCode: 301 } }` when the path has a slug-change redirect. OR `200 text/html` when `format=html`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — no published website, or the path is not in the live revision.

**PURPOSE:** Same as the home render-data endpoint but for a specific slug (`/about`, `/deep/path`).

**SEND:**
Required: `:slug` in the path. Query (optional): `format` (`json`|`html`).

**EXPECT:**
`200 JSON` page render data, OR `{ redirect: { to, statusCode } }`, OR `200 text/html`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** The storefront product grid.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing. Query (optional): `collectionId` (uuid), `tag` (≤100), `search` (≤200, name contains), `limit` (1–100, default 24), `cursor` (uuid).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ products: [ { id, name, slug, description, productType, media, tags, seo, variants: [ { id, sku, optionValues, priceAmount, compareAtAmount, currency, weightGrams, inStock: <boolean> } ], offers: [ { id, name, pricingMode, priceAmount, currency, badge, isDefault, lines: [ { variantId, quantity } ] } ] } ], nextCursor }`. Only `status:"active"` rows; exact stock counts are never exposed (only `inStock`).
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — workspace missing or not `active`.

**PURPOSE:** Product detail page.

**SEND:**
Required: `:idOrSlug` (a product uuid or its slug).

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ product: { ...public projection as in List Products, rating: { average: <number|null>, count }, reviews: [ { rating, comment, createdAt } ] } }`. `rating` and `reviews` are computed from **approved** reviews only.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — no active product with that id/slug, or workspace not active.

**PURPOSE:** A shopper leaves a review. **Public** — no login. Allowed only if the phone matches a Customer who has a **delivered** order containing this product.

**SEND:**
Required: `phone` (matched to a Customer by normalized number), `rating` (integer 1–5). Optional: `comment` (≤2000). One review per customer per product — submitting again updates the existing one and returns it to moderation.

**EXPECT:**
`201` (new) / `200` (updated) `{ review: { id, rating, comment, status:"pending" } }`. It is NOT shown publicly until staff approve it.
- `403 NO_DELIVERED_PURCHASE` — no matching customer, or no delivered order with this product.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — product not active in this workspace.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Storefront nav / collection list.

**SEND:**
Required: nothing.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ collections: [ { id, name, slug, description, seo } ] }`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — workspace not active.

**PURPOSE:** Collection landing page metadata (use List Products with `collectionId` for its items).

**SEND:**
Required: `:collectionId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ collection: { id, name, slug, description, seo } }`.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`.

**PURPOSE:** Turn the guest cart into a real order — the buyer's "Place order" button. Reuses the exact staff `orderService.createOrder` (server-side pricing, transactional inventory, idempotency).

**SEND:**
Header: `X-Cart-Token` (from POST `/store/:workspaceId/cart`), `Idempotency-Key` (required). Body — required: `contact` (`{ fullName, phone, alternatePhone?, email? }`), `paymentMethod` (`cod`|`card`|`wallet`|`bank_transfer`). Optional: `shippingAddress` (`{ country(2), province?, city, addressLine, postalCode?, notes? }`), `discountCode`, `funnelId`, `websiteId`, `notes`. **Items come from the cart, not the body.**

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ order: { ...full order, items: [...] } }`. The cart is marked `converted`.
- `400 CART_TOKEN_OR_ITEM_REQUIRED` — neither an `X-Cart-Token` header nor a Buy Now `item` was supplied.
- `404 CART_NOT_FOUND` — no active cart for that token in this workspace.
- `409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** Same `POST /store/:workspaceId/checkout` endpoint, **no `X-Cart-Token`** — the storefront "Buy now" button. Send a single `item` in the body and it goes straight to an order without ever touching a cart. Everything else (server-side pricing, transactional inventory reservation, idempotency, snapshots) is identical to the cart path.

**SEND:**
Header: `Idempotency-Key` (required). Body — required: `item` (`{ variantId, offerId?, quantity? }` — `quantity` defaults to 1), `contact`, `paymentMethod`. Optional: `shippingAddress`, `discountCode`, `funnelId`, `websiteId`, `notes`. If an `X-Cart-Token` header is also present, the cart wins and `item` is ignored.

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ order: { ...full order, items: [ <the one item> ] } }`. No cart row is created.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — the `variantId` is not an active variant in this workspace.
- `409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`.
- `400 CART_TOKEN_OR_ITEM_REQUIRED` — body had no `item`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — body/params failed the Joi schema; `error.details[]` names each bad field.

**PURPOSE:** A visitor enters (or resumes) a published funnel — returns the entry step to render.

**SEND:**
Required: `:funnelRef` (the funnel's uuid OR its `subdomain`), `visitorId` (1–64, your client-generated id). Optional: `attribution` (`{}` — utm / referrer / click ids).

**EXPECT:**
`201` `{ funnel: { id, name, subdomain }, session: { id, currentStepKey, path: [], status:"active", orderId:null }, step: { key, name, stepType, tree, seo }, offer?: { id, name, priceAmount, currency, badge, lines } }` (`offer` only for `upsell`/`downsell` steps). Save `session.id` for the next calls.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — funnel not found / not published.
- `410 FUNNEL_PAUSED` — funnel exists but is paused.

**PURPOSE:** Re-fetch the render data for wherever the session currently sits (page reload).

**SEND:**
Required: `:funnelId`, `:sessionId`.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ session: { id, currentStepKey, path, status, orderId }, step: {...}, offer? }` — OR `{ done: true, session }` when the session has completed.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — session/funnel/step not found.
- `410 FUNNEL_PAUSED`.

**PURPOSE:** Report what the visitor did on the current step; the engine picks the next step by matching edge conditions.

**SEND:**
Required: `outcome.type` — one of `completed_checkout` (include `outcome.orderId`), `accepted_offer`, `declined_offer`, `clicked_through`. On `accepted_offer` on an `upsell`/`downsell` step a follow-on order is created via `orderService` and linked to the session's original order.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ session: { ...currentStepKey, path }, step: {...}, offer?, followOnOrder?: { id, orderNumber, totalAmount, linkedFromOrderId } }` — OR `{ done: true, session }` when no outbound edge matches (funnel finished). `completed_checkout` also back-fills `orders.funnelId`.
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — `accepted_offer` on an upsell step but the session has no prior order.
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — session/step not found.

item.name: Public Shop
item.description:
`http://localhost:4000/shop/:workspaceId/*` — **PUBLIC, server-rendered HTML.** The EJS storefront viewer: what a buyer sees for a store built with **Store Branding & Products**.

⚠️ Host is `{{rootUrl}}` (`http://localhost:4000`), NOT `{{baseUrl}}` — these are mounted at the app root, outside `/api/v1`.

**Subdomain / custom domain:** the same pages are also served when the `Host` header is `<workspace-slug>.${PLATFORM_ROOT_DOMAIN}` or a **verified** custom domain (see **Custom Domains**) — the request is internally routed to this store, no redirect. To try it in Postman, send these requests to `http://<slug>.zimos.test:4000/` with the path stripped of `/shop/:workspaceId` (a hosts-file entry mapping that name to 127.0.0.1 is needed).

A custom storefront frontend would normally use **Public Storefront** (JSON) instead; this folder is the built-in no-frontend option.

item.name: Billing
item.description:
`/api/v1/billing/*` — subscription plumbing. **No real payment gateway is connected.**

**A frontend never calls the webhook.** It is server-to-server only (the payment gateway posts to it). It is included here for reference / local testing of the status-mapping logic.
`run-trial-check` is a platform-admin maintenance action.

item.name: Gateway Webhook (server-to-server — NOT a frontend call)

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** INTERNAL / server-to-server ONLY — the payment gateway calls this, never a browser or app frontend. Included so you can exercise the subscription status mapping locally.

**SEND:**
No auth header. `verifyGatewaySignature(payload, headers)` is currently a **stub that returns `true`** (TODO: implement per chosen gateway). Body: `{ type, data: { workspaceId? | externalSubscriptionId? } }`. Mapped `type`s: `subscription.activated` → `active`, `payment.failed` → `past_due`, `subscription.canceled`/`subscription.cancelled` → `cancelled`. Any other `type` is a no-op.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ received: true, handled: <boolean>, subscriptionId?, from?, status? }` (well-formed requests always 200 so the gateway does not retry-storm).
- `400 INVALID_SIGNATURE` — once the signature check is implemented.

**PURPOSE:** Sweep: flip trialing subscriptions whose trial has lapsed (and that have no real gateway subscription) to `past_due`. Manual now; a scheduler can call it later.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token of a **platform admin** (`users.platform_admin = true`). No body.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ expired: <count> }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — not a platform admin.

item.name: Admin (platform)
item.description:
`/api/v1/admin/*` — cross-tenant platform operator views. **Staff (Bearer) + the global `users.platform_admin` flag.** This bypasses workspace RBAC entirely and is NOT part of a normal merchant dashboard.

Set the flag in the DB for a test user: `UPDATE users SET platform_admin = true WHERE email = '...';`

request.description:
**PURPOSE:** Operator overview of every workspace on the platform with billing status.

**SEND:**
Required: Bearer token of a platform admin.

**EXPECT:**
`200` `{ workspaces: [ { workspaceId, workspaceName, plan, status, trialEndsAt, currentPeriodEnd, orderCount } ] }`.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — not a platform admin.

**PURPOSE:** A rendered HTML table of the same overview — openable directly in a browser.

**SEND:**
Auth via Bearer header OR `?token=<jwt>` (flexible). Must be a platform admin.

**EXPECT:**
`200` **text/html** — a table of workspace, plan, status, trial end, order count.
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` (no token anywhere).
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — not a platform admin.
